title: Dietary Guidelines for Americans, 2020-2025 (U.S. HHS / USDA)
content: Dietary Guidelines for Americans 2020-2025 (U.S. Departments of Health & Human Services and Agriculture) — Recommends limiting added sugars to less than 10% of total daily calories, saturated fat to less than 10% of total daily calories, and sodium to less than 2,300 mg/day for adults. Emphasizes a diet built around vegetables, fruits, whole grains, lean protein sources, and dairy/fortified alternatives, with nutrient-dense whole foods prioritized over highly processed foods and beverages.

title: Dietary Guidelines for Americans, 2020-2025 (U.S. HHS / USDA)
content: Dietary Guidelines 2020-2025 — Product implication: a generated meal plan should default toward whole, minimally-processed foods with adequate fiber, vegetables/fruit, and controlled sodium/added-sugar/saturated-fat content, rather than optimizing purely for hitting a calorie/macro number — these are the general population-health bounds this codebase's meal-optimizer serving-realism and food-diversity rules are meant to respect alongside the athlete-specific ISSN/ACSM guidance above.
